name: RepoLedger
absorption_note: Standalone governance console. It visualizes and records repository-boundary actions but is not itself a replacement for phenotype-registry or the managed source repositories.
rationale: Active public pnpm monorepo with a React/@xyflow ecosystem console and Go state/WebSocket backend. The local checkout is clean at the audited remote SHA; production build passes. No license file is present, so licensing must be resolved before redistribution or absorption.
